import (
	"github.com/alexisbcz/components/ui/card"
	"github.com/alexisbcz/components/ui/chart"
	selectui "github.com/alexisbcz/components/ui/select"
	h "github.com/alexisbcz/libhtml"
	"github.com/alexisbcz/libhtml/secure"
	"net/http"
)

// AreaInteractive is charts/chart-area-interactive: the time range select
// filters the data. The initial range ("90d") keeps every entry; on change,
// interactive.js filters the data with upstream's date arithmetic and
// updates the chart through its el.chart API.
func AreaInteractive(r *http.Request) h.Node {
	config := chart.Config{
		{Key: "visitors", Label: "Visitors"},
		{Key: "desktop", Label: "Desktop", Color: "var(--chart-1)"},
		{Key: "mobile", Label: "Mobile", Color: "var(--chart-2)"},
	}
	day := chart.DateFormat("en-US", map[string]string{"month": "short", "day": "numeric"})
	return card.Card(h.Class("pt-0"),
		card.Header(h.Class("flex items-center gap-2 space-y-0 border-b py-5 sm:flex-row"),
			h.Div(h.Class("grid flex-1 gap-1"),
				card.Title("Area Chart - Interactive"),
				card.Description("Showing total visitors for the last 3 months"),
			),
			selectui.Select(selectui.DefaultValue("90d"),
				selectui.Trigger(h.Class("hidden w-[160px] rounded-lg sm:ml-auto sm:flex"), h.Aria("label", "Select a value"),
					selectui.Value(selectui.Placeholder("Last 3 months")),
				),
				selectui.Content(h.Class("rounded-xl"),
					selectui.Item(selectui.ItemValue("90d"), h.Class("rounded-lg"), "Last 3 months"),
					selectui.Item(selectui.ItemValue("30d"), h.Class("rounded-lg"), "Last 30 days"),
					selectui.Item(selectui.ItemValue("7d"), h.Class("rounded-lg"), "Last 7 days"),
				),
			),
		),
		card.Content(h.Class("px-2 pt-4 sm:px-6 sm:pt-6"),
			// React's useId gives the Select its id first, so the chart's
			// generated id is the second one: _r_1_.
			chart.Container(config, nonce(r), chart.ID("_r_1_"), h.Class("aspect-auto h-[250px] w-full"),
				chart.AreaChart(chart.Data(dataAreaInteractive),
					chart.Defs(gradient("fillDesktop", "desktop"), gradient("fillMobile", "mobile")),
					noVertical(),
					chart.XAxis(chart.DataKey("date"), chart.TickLine(false), chart.AxisLine(false), chart.TickMargin(8), chart.MinTickGap(32), chart.TickFormatter(day)),
					chart.Tooltip(chart.Cursor(false), chart.TooltipContent(chart.LabelFormatter(day), chart.Indicator("dot"))),
					stackedAreas("url(#fillMobile)", "url(#fillDesktop)", false),
					chart.Legend(chart.LegendContent()),
				),
			),
		),
	)
}

func nonce(r *http.Request) chart.Nonce { return chart.Nonce(secure.Nonce(r)) }

func gradient(id, key string) *chart.Node {
	return chart.El("linearGradient", chart.P("id", id), chart.P("x1", "0"), chart.P("y1", "0"), chart.P("x2", "0"), chart.P("y2", "1"),
		chart.El("stop", chart.P("offset", "5%"), chart.P("stopColor", "var(--color-"+key+")"), chart.P("stopOpacity", 0.8)),
		chart.El("stop", chart.P("offset", "95%"), chart.P("stopColor", "var(--color-"+key+")"), chart.P("stopOpacity", 0.1)),
	)
}

func noVertical() *chart.Node { return chart.CartesianGrid(chart.Vertical(false)) }

func stackedAreas(fillMobile, fillDesktop string, opacity bool) []*chart.Node {
	area := func(key, fill string) *chart.Node {
		return chart.Area(chart.DataKey(key), chart.Type("natural"), chart.Fill(fill),
			func() any {
				if opacity {
					return chart.FillOpacity(0.4)
				}
				return nil
			}(),
			chart.Stroke("var(--color-"+key+")"), chart.StackID("a"))
	}
	return []*chart.Node{area("mobile", fillMobile), area("desktop", fillDesktop)}
}

import (

	"strconv"
)

func BarInteractive(r *http.Request) h.Node {
	config := interactiveConfig("var(--chart-2)", "var(--chart-1)")
	return card.Card(h.Class("py-0"),
		card.Header(h.Class("flex flex-col items-stretch border-b p-0! sm:flex-row"),
			h.Div(h.Class("flex flex-1 flex-col justify-center gap-1 px-6 pt-4 pb-3 sm:py-0!"),
				card.Title("Bar Chart - Interactive"),
				card.Description("Showing total visitors for the last 3 months"),
			),
			seriesButtons(config, "relative z-30 flex flex-1 flex-col justify-center gap-1 border-t px-6 py-4 text-left even:border-l data-[active=true]:bg-muted/50 sm:border-t-0 sm:border-l sm:px-8 sm:py-6"),
		),
		card.Content(h.Class("px-2 sm:p-6"),
			chart.Container(config, nonce(r), h.Class("aspect-auto h-[250px] w-full"),
				chart.BarChart(chart.AccessibilityLayer(), chart.Data(dataBarInteractive), edgeMargin,
					noVertical(), dateAxis(), dateTooltip(true),
					chart.Bar(chart.DataKey("desktop"), chart.Fill("var(--color-desktop)")),
				),
			),
		),
	)
}

var interactiveConfig = func(desktop, mobile string) chart.Config {
	return chart.Config{
		{Key: "views", Label: "Page Views"},
		{Key: "desktop", Label: "Desktop", Color: desktop},
		{Key: "mobile", Label: "Mobile", Color: mobile},
	}
}

func seriesButtons(config chart.Config, buttonClass string) h.Node {
	buttons := make([]any, 0, 2)
	for _, key := range []string{"desktop", "mobile"} {
		item, _ := config.Get(key)
		buttons = append(buttons, h.Button(
			h.Data("active", strconv.FormatBool(key == "desktop")),
			h.Class(buttonClass),
			h.Span(h.Class("text-xs text-muted-foreground"), item.Label),
			h.Span(h.Class("text-lg leading-none font-bold sm:text-3xl"), localeString(total(dataBarInteractive, key))),
		))
	}
	return h.Div(h.Class("flex"), buttons)
}

// localeString formats n like Number.prototype.toLocaleString("en-US").
func localeString(n int) string {
	s := strconv.Itoa(n)
	out := make([]byte, 0, len(s)+len(s)/3)
	for i := range s {
		if i > 0 && (len(s)-i)%3 == 0 {
			out = append(out, ',')
		}
		out = append(out, s[i])
	}
	return string(out)
}

func total(rows []chart.Row, key string) int {
	t := 0
	for _, r := range rows {
		t += r[key].(int)
	}
	return t
}

func nonce(r *http.Request) chart.Nonce { return chart.Nonce(secure.Nonce(r)) }

var dataLineInteractive = dataAreaInteractive

var edgeMargin = chart.Margin{Left: 12, Right: 12}

func noVertical() *chart.Node { return chart.CartesianGrid(chart.Vertical(false)) }

func dateAxis() *chart.Node {
	return chart.XAxis(chart.DataKey("date"), chart.TickLine(false), chart.AxisLine(false), chart.TickMargin(8), chart.MinTickGap(32),
		chart.TickFormatter(chart.DateFormat("en-US", map[string]string{"month": "short", "day": "numeric"})))
}

func dateTooltip(cursor bool) *chart.Node {
	content := chart.TooltipContent(chart.ClassName("w-[150px]"), chart.NameKey("views"),
		chart.LabelFormatter(chart.DateFormat("en-US", map[string]string{"month": "short", "day": "numeric", "year": "numeric"})))
	if cursor {
		return chart.Tooltip(content)
	}
	return chart.Tooltip(chart.Cursor(false), content)
}
